name: John Deere Parts Distribution Center - Waterloo IA

fieldNotes.site: Confirmed John Deere Parts Distribution Center at 2280 Northeast Dr, Waterloo IA, NE of the city in an edge-of-town industrial area. Panjiva buyer report and Waze list this address; Ryder Integrated Logistics operates 3PL logistics on site (typical for a Deere parts DC). A blue 'JOHN DEERE' monument sign at the entrance was visible in Street View, positively identifying the property.
fieldNotes.buildings: Two buildings on one campus: a large gray-roofed distribution warehouse running N-S (the main DC) and a separate blue-roofed building to its north (offices / secondary warehouse). multipleFacilities = true.
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE. The single truck entrance off Northeast Dr is a wide open driveway apron with generous radii. Street View from 2021-06 (inside, looking N and S) and 2025-03 (from the public road looking S into the entrance) both show NO barrier arm, NO sliding/swing gate, and NO guard booth - only a JD monument sign on the grass. Uncontrolled open entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No staffed booth at or near the entrance in any Street View heading. The only small structure is the JD sign monument.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: FALSE. remoteGs requires a truck gate to exist; there is no gate, so false.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE. A large paved/graded apron sits between the entrance and the dock face / drop yard, plus a gravel staging area NE of the blue building - ample room for trucks to hold inside the property before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: TRUE. The entrance driveway runs a long distance (several hundred feet) from Northeast Dr south along the west side before reaching the buildings and yard - easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: TRUE. The entrance is a very wide unmarked apron with no gate hardware; abundant paved width to add an express / bypass lane if a gate were ever installed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50 band, MEDIUM confidence. The gray DC building's east face has dock doors with trailers backed in along most of its ~700ft+ length; the blue building has a smaller dock bank on its SE corner. Overhead count of backed-in trailers and door rhythm supports ~40 doors; the true total for a parts DC of this size could reach 50+. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+. A large dedicated drop yard runs along the entire east side of the gray building with multiple rows of parked trailers - clearly 50+ stalls of unhitched trailer storage. dropYard = true.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~65 trailers counted across the drop yard and dock face in the captured z18-z20 imagery; approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~90, estimated from the marked-row drop-yard footprint east of the building.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: FALSE. All loading docks are on the east building face (single-sided); no second dock bank on a different face for separate ship vs receive.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: TRUE. One combined entrance/exit driveway off Northeast Dr; no separate in-gate/out-gate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural. The site sits in an edge-of-town industrial pocket NE of Waterloo, ringed by active farmland - not dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: FALSE (medium confidence). Edge-of-town location with a neighboring industrial campus and nearby Waterloo development; cellular coverage is likely adequate. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: FALSE. No rail spur runs into the property; access is highway/road only.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~45 acres, derived from the perimeter box (~565 m N-S x ~320 m E-W of used property). Estimate.
fieldNotes.scale: FALSE. No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path.

citations.claim: Deere Worldwide Parts location list includes a Waterloo IA parts distribution center.
John Deere's Waterloo IA operations are an active, currently operating Deere complex.

verification.rationale: Deere-operated Parts Distribution Center at 2280 Northeast Dr, Waterloo IA (matches lat/lng); part of the active Waterloo footprint.
